dataset_manifest.tokenizer: GPT-2 byte-level BPE; CR/LF removed; line EOS; no prefix space, BOS or truncation

source_dataset.export: UTF-8 text rows; append LF only when absent; empty rows become blank lines

summary.scope: fixed stream probe; interventions start from the normal trajectory

gate_statistics.scope: equally weighted measured segments and examples; no training-time history

interpretation.gate_scope: Per-example gates on the fixed validation probe; not training trajectories
interpretation.slot_scope: Reset one slot to learned initial S0; contributions are not additive
interpretation.retention_scope: Swap once, then propagate the altered branch; lag0=current segment
interpretation.attention_scope: Write pooling attention is not token-to-register read attention
